description: Contemporary single-family home just minutes from Brickell and the waterfront. The main level features an open-concept living and dining area with oversized windows that fill the space with natural light. A chef-inspired kitchen offers granite countertops, stainless appliances, gas range, and a walk-in pantry. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a private balcony, large walk-in closet, and spa-style bath with dual vanities and frameless glass shower. Outside, enjoy a covered patio, saltwater pool, and outdoor kitchen ideal for year-round entertaining. Located on a quiet street with quick access to I-95, top-rated schools, and the best of Miami nightlife and dining.

Bayfront luxury condo in a recently completed high-rise overlooking Biscayne Bay. This corner residence offers floor-to-ceiling glass in every room, an expansive wraparound balcony, and unobstructed water and city views. The modern kitchen features quartz countertops, European cabinetry, and integrated appliances. A split floor plan provides privacy, with a generous primary suite that includes a walk-in closet and spa bathroom with soaking tub and rain shower. Building amenities rival a five-star resort with infinity-edge pool, state-of-the-art gym, spa, club room, and on-site café. Located in Edgewater, you are minutes from Wynwood, Midtown, Design District, and downtown Miami.

Charming Old Spanish style home in the leafy Roads neighborhood, blending historic character with modern updates. A welcoming front porch leads to a spacious living room with wood-beamed ceilings, hardwood floors, and a decorative fireplace. The updated kitchen features white shaker cabinets, subway tile backsplash, and stainless appliances opening to a casual dining nook. Four well-sized bedrooms include a first-floor guest room that doubles as a home office. French doors open to a covered patio overlooking a private, fenced yard with room for a pool. Tree-lined streets, sidewalks, and proximity to Brickell, Coconut Grove, and Key Biscayne make this a coveted central Miami location.

High-floor Brickell waterfront residence with sweeping views of Biscayne Bay and the Miami skyline. The open-concept living area features floor-to-ceiling glass, porcelain tile flooring, and direct balcony access. A chef's kitchen offers an oversized island, gas cooktop, and premium appliance package. The split-bedroom layout includes two guest suites and a primary bedroom with custom walk-in closet and ensuite bath with double vanities and glass-enclosed shower. Building amenities include a bayside pool deck, fitness center, tennis courts, dog park, children's playroom, and 24-hour concierge. Walk to Brickell City Centre, restaurants, and corporate offices while still enjoying a quiet residential feel.

Move-in ready single-story home in Miami's Shorecrest neighborhood, just a few blocks from the bay. The home features a spacious living room, separate dining area, and updated kitchen with granite counters and ample cabinet space. Three comfortable bedrooms include a primary suite with renovated bath and walk-in shower. French doors open to a covered terrace overlooking a lush, fully fenced backyard with room for a pool or play set. Additional features include impact windows, one-car garage, and gated driveway. Enjoy quick access to Miami Shores, Biscayne Boulevard shops and cafés, and major highways while living on a quiet residential street with mature trees.

Modern tri-level townhouse in a small gated community just west of Brickell. The ground floor includes a two-car garage and flexible bonus room ideal for office or gym. Main living level features an open kitchen with granite countertops, stainless appliances, and breakfast bar overlooking the dining and living rooms. Upstairs you'll find three bedrooms, including a primary suite with balcony and walk-in closet. A small fenced patio provides space for grilling or container gardening. Low HOA, impact windows, and proximity to Brickell, Little Havana, and major expressways make this an excellent option for buyers seeking urban convenience without high-rise condo fees.

Bright and airy condo in the heart of Aventura within walking distance to shopping, dining, and parks. This 2-bedroom split floor plan offers a spacious living area that opens to a balcony with city views. The kitchen features granite countertops, wood cabinetry, and stainless appliances. Both bedrooms offer generous closets and ensuite bathrooms, making it ideal for roommates or guests. Building amenities include a resort-style pool, hot tub, fitness center, club room, and 24-hour security. Aventura Mall, Gulfstream Park, and the beaches are all just a short drive away, providing endless options for entertainment and recreation.

Well-maintained single-family home in a quiet gated community near the Dolphin Expressway and Florida Turnpike. The open living and dining areas flow into a spacious kitchen featuring ample counter space and breakfast bar. Split-bedroom layout offers privacy, with a primary suite overlooking the backyard canal and featuring dual closets and ensuite bath. Enjoy evenings on the covered terrace with serene water views and room for outdoor seating. Community amenities include a pool, clubhouse, and security patrol. Conveniently located near Dolphin Mall, Miami International Mall, and major employment centers in Doral and the Airport West submarket.

Luxury waterfront condo in a boutique tower overlooking the Intracoastal Waterway and ocean skyline. A private elevator foyer opens directly into the residence, where floor-to-ceiling glass walls frame spectacular views from every room. The open living space features a gourmet kitchen with Italian cabinetry, quartz counters, and Sub-Zero/Wolf appliance package. An oversized balcony with summer kitchen is perfect for outdoor dining and enjoying sunrise or sunset. The primary suite includes a large custom closet and spa bathroom with soaking tub and rain shower. Building offers full-service amenities including resort pool, spa, fitness center, kids room, valet, and 24/7 concierge.

Affordable single-family home with solid construction and thoughtful updates, ideal for first-time buyers or investors. The interior features a comfortable living room, separate dining area, and updated kitchen with newer cabinets, countertops, and appliances. Three bedrooms provide flexibility for guests or a home office. Bathrooms have been refreshed with modern tile and fixtures. Outside, a generous fenced yard offers space for pets, entertaining, or future expansion, plus a storage shed for tools or bikes. Centrally located near major highways, the airport, and downtown, this home provides easy access to employment centers and Miami's growing tech and health districts.

Spacious condo near Florida International University, ideal for students, faculty, or investors seeking strong rental demand. The unit offers a functional split-bedroom layout with two large bedrooms and two full baths. An open living and dining area flows to a balcony with community views. The kitchen includes plenty of cabinet space, breakfast bar, and full-size appliances. In-unit washer and dryer, two assigned parking spaces, and gated access add convenience and security. The community features a pool, clubhouse, and well-maintained common areas. Easy access to major highways, shopping centers, and public transportation makes this a highly practical West Miami location.

Stylish four-bedroom home in Miami's Upper Eastside, surrounded by mature trees and lush landscaping. The open living area features vaulted ceilings, recessed lighting, and sliding glass doors that blur the line between indoor and outdoor living. A chef's kitchen with quartz countertops, large island, and stainless appliances anchors the space. The primary suite opens directly to the backyard oasis, where you'll find a wood deck, outdoor shower, and room for pool or garden beds. Additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, office, or gym. All within minutes of MiMo restaurants, Miami Shores Country Club, and the beaches via the 79th Street Causeway.
